name: Policy Administration and Compliance Evidence
description: Design the central policy administration model and compliance evidence pack generation. Define policy data model (categories, scopes, enforcement points), policy lifecycle (draft, review, active, retired), and policy evaluation engine. Design compliance evidence packs as versioned bundles of policy snapshots, attestations, audit receipts, and configuration state that can be exported for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP audits.
purpose: Organizations need a centralized policy framework to define, deploy, and enforce governance rules across tenants, workspaces, and data flows. Compliance evidence packs automate audit preparation by collecting attestation-ready snapshots of the system's policy state.
acceptanceCriteria: Policy model document defines categories, scopes, enforcement points, and lifecycle states with transition rules
Evidence pack schema defines versioned bundle format including policy snapshots, attestations, audit receipts, and configuration state
Architecture covers automated evidence collection triggers and export mechanism for audit readiness
